Usage: diff [-qsauciwbBZrN] [-U LINES | -C LINES] [--label LABEL] FILE1 FILE2
      --help      display this help and exit
      --version   display version and exit
Compare files, directories or one stdin operand. Normal, unified and context output.
-q reports differences only; -s reports equality; -a treats binary input as text.
-i ignores ASCII case; -w ignores whitespace; -b ignores changes in whitespace.
-Z ignores trailing whitespace; -B ignores blank-only change groups.
--strip-trailing-cr removes one CR before each LF on input, including displayed lines.
-r recurses; -N treats missing files as empty; --unidirectional-new-file applies only to the left side.
Timestamp headers use TZ=UTC or public TZif files; label stdin explicitly.
Non-C locale collation and link-target-text comparison remain unsupported.
